theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (H : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (w : ℕ → Euclid n → ℕ) (ζ : ℕ → Euclid n → MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (H i)) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) → (∀ i, ∀ a ∈ B i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (H i) a) → (∀ i, H i '' B i ⊆ U) → (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) → (∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (ζ i) (volume.restrict (B i))) → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict (B i)), ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ i a α = s * α (fun j => fderiv ℝ (H i) a (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∑' i, ∫⁻ a in B i, (w i a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (H i) a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (H i) a).det)) ∂volume ≠ ∞ → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun i => ∫ a in B i, (w i a : ℝ) * ζ i a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (H i a)) ∂volume) (R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))
